== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34714) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Wishniewski DS BHBM.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>d4104dd04c300a9f14bd3de68d6fe87e6b4dd952c3e808c7c483759a7b505e5d</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>207_30</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Grand Admiral Thrawn (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.

=== Pending preservation ===
The individual PC deck post still needs a verified preservation capture. This outstanding work is recorded under Story 386 and Bug 407. Bill authorized publication of the checked content while that capture remains outstanding; the source has not been marked fully preserved.
